summary: Recent coverage highlights ongoing advocacy efforts around D.C. statehood, including commitments from lawmakers and concerns about federal control of local institutions like the National Guard. The headlines underscore how current events continue to motivate calls for greater local autonomy. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
